content.title: Milwaukee Bucks at Phoenix Suns - Where to Watch, Stream Info, TV Channel, and Live Updates (March 21, 2026)
content.text: The Milwaukee Bucks will face off against the Phoenix Suns in a matchup featuring two teams currently struggling to find their rhythm. The Bucks enter the game with a record of 28-41, having lost their last two contests. They are led by Giannis Antetokounmpo, who averages 27.6 points and 9.8 rebounds per game, although he will be sidelined due to injury. On the other side, the Suns hold a record of 39-31 but are also on a four-game losing streak. Devin Booker leads the team with 25.8 points per game and contributes 5.9 assists. Both teams will be looking to break their losing streaks and gain momentum as the season progresses.
